content.text: **Summary:** I resolved ticket T-2009 by analyzing the pod logs and identifying that the pricing-engine crash loop is caused by an application bug, not a Kubernetes issue. The pods are crashing during startup when compiling a pricing rule due to an index out of range error in the tier lookup code. The fix requires the development team to correct the off-by-one error in /src/internal/rules/tiers.go and review the "BF-2026-STACKED" rule configuration.
